title: ADH: hormone supply, renal response, and water balance

stages.title: Stimulus and sensor
stages.text: Higher plasma osmolality or lower circulating volume signals for ADH.

stages.title: Synthesis, storage, release
stages.text: Synthesis occurs in the hypothalamus. Storage and release occur in the posterior pituitary.

stages.title: Water reabsorption
stages.text: ADH increases collecting-duct water permeability. More water returns to blood.

stages.title: Two DI mechanisms
stages.text: Neurogenic DI lacks adequate ADH. Nephrogenic DI has renal insensitivity to ADH. Both impair urine concentration.
